title: Pack
description: Declared content of the physical item a catalog variant sells. Measures are stated at one level: on `pack` for the whole item, or in `contained` for one of the identical inner units the item holds. An omitted member is not stated.

net_content.description: GS1 `netContent` of the whole item: the declared amount of product, such as a mass, a volume or a count. Its integer `value` MUST be at least 1. Absent when `contained` is present.

drained_weight.description: GS1 `drainedWeight` of the whole item: the declared weight of the product after its liquid is drained. Its `unit` MUST be a unit of mass and its integer `value` MUST be at least 1. Absent when `contained` is present.

contained.description: The identical inner units the item holds, such as the cans in a case. Its measures describe one inner unit. Absent when the inner units differ or nest further.

count.description: Number of identical inner units in the item.

net_content.description: GS1 `netContent` of one inner unit: the declared amount of product, such as a mass, a volume or a count. Its integer `value` MUST be at least 1.

drained_weight.description: GS1 `drainedWeight` of one inner unit: the declared weight of the product after its liquid is drained. Its `unit` MUST be a unit of mass and its integer `value` MUST be at least 1.
